subject: pyths 0.2.3

boundaries.name: metaclasses
boundaries.reason: `class X(metaclass=Meta)` keyword base rejected at parse; metaclasses out-of-fragment. Expansion lane: parser/E4.

boundaries.name: proxies
boundaries.reason: __getattr__/__setattr__/__dict__ attribute interception unsupported. Expansion lane: E4 receiver-dispatch model.

boundaries.name: async_await_UNDER_CONSTRUCTION
boundaries.reason: async/await SUPPORTED (asyncio.gather interleave byte-identical); upstream testlet uses deprecated pre-3.10 asyncio API. Measured by percheck.py::score_async (reference-app experiments/autotester-ps).

boundaries.name: modules
boundaries.reason: multi-file package imports; dotted `import a.b.c` (no `as`) emits invalid JS — REAL BUG, tracked as its own issue (E7 sub-part 5; FULL_SURFACE NEW BUGS #1). Runner: packages_ps.py.

boundaries.name: div_issues
boundaries.reason: multi-file + globals() unsupported (+ generators/re/opov). Runner: packages_ps.py.

boundaries.name: div_pulls
boundaries.reason: multi-file submodule-as-name re-export unsupported. Runner: packages_ps.py.

boundaries.name: globals_function
boundaries.reason: globals() dynamic-globals assignment unsupported. Runner: packages_ps.py.

boundaries.name: module_random
boundaries.reason: PRNG values match by property (range/permutation); seeded byte-equality impossible by design (different PRNG). random.seed() unsupported (gap). Runner: manual_ps.py.

boundaries.name: static_types
boundaries.reason: upstream test is a mypy static-check (out of runtime scope); runtime annotations accepted+ignored, matching CPython. Runner: manual_ps.py.

boundaries.name: incidental_tests
boundaries.reason: default object str() prints '{}' vs CPython '<...object at 0x...>' (FULL_SURFACE NEW BUGS #3); other cases multi-file/build boundaries. Runner: manual_ps.py.

boundaries.name: transcrypt_and_python_results_differ
boundaries.reason: differentiation showcase: Transcrypt writes DOM branch; PythScribe prints the CPython branch. CPython-faithful.

boundaries.name: transcrypt_only
boundaries.reason: differentiation showcase: -3 % 8 -> 5 (Python modulo) and `x in <non-container>` -> TypeError, both CPython-faithful where Transcrypt diverges.

boundaries.name: async_await_manual
boundaries.reason: same async surface as the automated testlet; measured once by percheck.py::score_async, not re-run.

_comment: TWO-SIDED ratchet baseline for run_autotester.py: any per-testlet change (regression OR improvement) fails CI until this file is updated in the same PR. `boundaries` = the 13 full-surface dispositions (E7 sub-part 5): 2 measured live by this gate, 11 pinned from the dedicated harnesses (reference-app experiments/autotester-ps FULL_SURFACE.md). Oracle: CPython only (PYTHS_ORACLE_PYTHON) — never Transcrypt's expected outputs.
